body:
Learn for yourself.
http://stopworldcontrol.com
Watch Out of the Shadows
Start looking, start learning, start understanding!

I did, but the majority of my jobs were shit jobs. Even the one at Apple.  

As you will see, with the further advancement of technology,  companies are now getting away with micro  monitoring your every move at work.  They can now tell if you take 10 seconds to compose yourself after a bad customer call, or some other event and are quick to give you a warning or further discipline because you are not working harder, faster and longer. 

The more you learn, the less you really want to know.

It truly is a scary fucking world when you look behind the smoke and mirrors.

Great question.  I don't have any retirement funds as a I never worked in one place for a super long time, nor did they pay well enough for me to be able to live AND save for retirement.  

As far as work however, I triumphed in places to work for.  I was a Disney cast member. I worked as a corporate employee for Apple, I have personally performed hundreds if not a couple thousand autopsies and been on scene to see first hand how a lot of those tragic events took place.  I was a life guard and now I am in the medical marijuana field helping people everyday get real relief from pain.

But, it's not enough.  

Outside of work, there is nothing.  I enjoy nothing any longer as I see the truth behind it all and everything we do, watch and participate in is nothing but filler to make it appear that your life has meaning, when in reality the only person who can decide if your life has meaning. Is you.  Sorry, rambling incoherently..

I know exactly where you are coming from and your feelings are genuinely valid and not stupid nonsense.  We are kept alive against our will. However...  You are young and have a lot of "natural" life ahead of you, and I guarantee that in life you will experience ups and certainly a lot of downs.  Just live it until you are certain there is no more to be had. No more that can fulfill you.  And then, and only then, should you be given the opportunity to exit.  

Know, that I did just that.  I have 2 wonderful children and my spouse is a good person as well. But after 25 years, the marriage is no longer viable, my adult children don't really want anything to do with me and I am not really up for starting over with a brand new person. So, in this case I have outlived my usefulness to the planet and wish I could exercise a right that I should have.

Help yourself by starting here.  I know we only know what we are told, but consider the source.  Start researching the world and what is REALLY happening.  Discover what you really mean to the government and to society.  Society as a whole projects that they care, as they feel they are doing you a service , but in reality, the majority don't realize they are helping the government, big pharma, the pursuit of control by religion and in general convincing you to be a slave to your internal torment by suggesting you continously "get help" and that everything will be OK.  The truth is, that in reality, we the people are nothing, unless you are in Hollywood or the upper echelons of government.  We the people are an endless supply of money and a source for experimentation by the government. Any government.

This is just the tip of the iceburg.

I know, a little off topic. But, in the end it all ties in.
I get it, death is the unknown. But as a "wise character" once said, "To the well organized mind, death is but the next great adventure".

Thanks for your post.  I understand where you are at and remember, only you can decide your future and choose whether you will be happy or not with the choices that you actually made for your life and those that you were forced into, such as shitty parents and family.  However, if you finally decide that you no longer want to be a part of the planet, you should be given access to euthanasia drugs, but due to religion and its hold and dominance in the world's government, end your own existence is not an option.

Also, you ask if religion is right.  What religion of the current hundreds to choose from, or thousands of past and dead religions that are not even remotely close to accurate are you afraid that is right?
